description: Free. What a wallet holds, read from the chain (both token programs, not just coins it bought through us): at most 100 positions are listed (the ones we can price first, largest value first; `omitted` counts the rest) — each with its current market cap and price (its last bonding-curve or PumpSwap trade, null when the index does not know the mint), its value in SOL and USDC, and the page where the wallet signs its own sale of it. total_sol and total_usd sum the listed positions only: say so when omitted is more than 0. Kept five minutes per wallet. For: what do I hold, what is this wallet's portfolio worth, what can I sell.
name: my_positions
